theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_l1_scalar_test_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (c : ℝ) (Y : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (u : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Y k ω = ∫ y in U, u k y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Tendsto (fun k => Y k ω) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid n) n) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))))) → ∀ b : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) b → HasCompactSupport b → tsupport b ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y in U, u k y * b y) atTop (𝓝 (c * ∫ y, b y))
